title: Add editing and a filter in the URL hash
goal: Add editing to the todo page: double-click a todo's text to edit it, Enter saves the change, Escape cancels it. Keep the filter in the URL hash (#/all, #/active, #/done) so a reload or a shared link opens the same filter.

grader.reason: Needs a browser. hidden/grade.mjs is a Playwright script that this harness does not run.
